verdict.rationale: An authenticator app could plausibly offer in-app AI suggestions, such as security or organization insights about stored accounts, so this question applies to Ente Auth. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The documented features are QR scanning, imports, encrypted backups, sharing, notes, trash, and lock screens, and the llms.txt probe is a docs file for external LLMs, not an in-product AI feature.
